== Objectives ==
Gather 8 Windhorn Relics for Tarwegg Dustbrow within Windhorn Canyon and return to him in Ironforge.
* [[Windhorn Relic]] (8)

== Description ==
You there, explorer! Have you heard of the sacred canyon of the tauren, where houses are etched in rock and tunnels delve beneath the earth?

If you had told me this story a few weeks ago, I would simply have laughed at you for such tales, but now I have come to find out that this story is truth! A reliable source of mine has told me about a place known as Windhorn Canyon nestled in Thousand Needles. Only recently discovered due to some battle that has taken place within. Now, as my source tells me, it is teeming with Grimtotem.

Regardless of whatever evil lurks there, I wish to commission your services to return some of the relics that may linger there. Do this right, and you shall be paid appropriately!

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 2350 XP

== Progress ==
Remember, the Canyon is located deep within Thousand Needles, you will need to travel to the far corners of Kalimdor to find it.

== Completion ==
Magnificent, I was once as ignorant to think the Tauren had no history, and just wandered plains like nomads. This certainly has changed my view upon them as a whole.

You have done well adventurer, please, take this coin for doing such brave, and noble work.
